catalogue.note: The Direct Debit logo is the file’s own image fill (“Unknown 1”, a 350×111 PNG) embedded as it came. The hidden Frame 1 is not built. The recurring icon is flipped vertically and turned 180° in the file, which mirrors it left to right. The two-line switch label is 120% of 12px, which Figma lays out on 14px lines. The 28px header, the 10px copy, 23%, 1st, the grey placeholders and the Direct Debit title move down 1px: a measured correction, not a Figma value.
